report.clinical_summary: A 30-something software developer presents with a new, tender neck lump (2 weeks) and fatigue (1 month) that started around the same time. No recent infections, fever, or weight change. Sedentary work, some stress but manageable. Family history: father with leukemia, mother with breast cancer. Physical exam shows an isolated, possibly reactive lymph node. Plan: blood work, ultrasound, follow-up in 1 week.
